dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Can anyone recommend a truly skilled doctor? My wife's been getting more sick by the day — but every physician we've consulted can't even identify the cause of her illness!"

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "Her condition just keeps getting worse. These days, she can only stay awake for four hours a day... Please, someone, help us!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "How about you try going elsewhere? There are better doctors in Sumeru, Liyue, or maybe Fontaine... I don't think there's much hope asking around in a place like this."

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "I thought so too, but my wife can't leave Nod-Krai. Without kuuvahki, she'll die!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "Huh? I've only heard of people who can't adapt well TO kuuvahki, and even some of those Frostmoon Scions have folks like that... Is it even possible to die from a lack of it?"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "It's true! Without kuuvahki, she can't fly, and her face gets all blurry and laggy... Just watching her makes my heart shatter!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "She can't fly, and her face... Wait, your wife's a robot?! Man, I think YOU need to see a doctor more than she does!"

dialogues.speaker: Reply
dialogues.text: "No! I refuse! No matter what anyone tells me, she's my darling wife, who has silently hovered by my side all this time!"

dialogues.speaker: Another Person's Message
dialogues.text: "...Alright, suit yourself, mate. But I'll throw you a bone: Go look for Aino."
